      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.275" rpy="0 0 0"/>

               iyy="2.0523" iyz="0.0"

  <link name="chest_lid">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.205 0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.72 0.41 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown_dark">
        <color rgba="0.4 0.2 0.05 1"/>

    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.1"/>
